'''Hes Glillto''' was the alias that [[Lai Nootka]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]], used when he entered the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Like Nootka's other aliases, he created it by mixing and matching the first and last names of characters that appeared in a series of Durosian young-adult novels.<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

During the last days of the [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]] used the alias to make contact with Celchu's [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]], [[Nawara Ven]].<ref name="KT" />
